theater: 遼東安市城與鴨綠水下游

battle.name: 唐與高句麗戰爭
battle.theater: 遼東安市城與鴨綠水下游
battle.brief: 貞觀十九年(645)正月唐太宗下詔東征，三月李勣拔蓋牟城，四月主力合圍遼東安市城，築土山逼近城垣，以拋石機居高臨下壓制城頭，所中皆中、人馬多斃，圍城六十餘日終不能下，七月詔班師。卡面羅馬扭力弩砲代表以機械蓄能、專獵城頭守軍的投射技術譜系，唐軍拋石車即是這條譜系的東方對應物。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 唐與高句麗之戰，是唐太宗貞觀十九年(645)對東北亞高句麗政權的第一次大規模用兵。開戰方是唐：正月下詔東征，尚書左僕射李勣率主力自代州出北山道，李靖總攝東征諸軍。長孫無忌、楊師道、劉勣等將兵及運丁數十萬，自萊州循海道北上，幽州、營州充當轉運樞紐，山東倉廩沿海船與陸路輸送到鴨綠水一線。守方是高句麗：以王都平壤為中心，安東大都督府統轄遼東、鴨綠江兩側的蓋牟、安市、遼陽諸城與山城，國王高建武坐鎮，王弟男建等統兵。渤海靺鞨部首領安市王率眾歸唐，把遼東的門戶交到唐軍手上；新羅王善德遣將金庾信在東南攻破高句麗多座城邑，百濟王義慈表面遣使朝貢、暗中與唐謀議里應外合。東亞三國的連動，使這場戰爭不再是唐與高句麗兩家的單獨較量。作戰兵種上，唐以步騎混編的野戰軍配合攻城器械部隊為主，高句麗則依靠山城工事、弓弩與城頭投石，兩軍都沒有能一擊定局的投射手段。
countriesEn: The Tang-Goguryeo War was the first large-scale campaign that Emperor Taizong of Tang, in the nineteenth year of the Zhenguan era (645), launched against the northeastern Asian kingdom of Goguryeo. The attacking side was Tang. An edict was issued in the first month of the year: Li Ji, Senior Vice President of State Affairs, led the main body of the army out of Dai prefecture by the northern route, while Li Jing exercised overall command over all the columns. Zhangsun Wuji, Yang Shidao and Liu Ji took several hundred thousand men and draughtsmen by sea from Laizhou, and Youzhou and Yingzhou served as the transfer hubs, with the granaries of Shandong feeding the army by coastal shipping and by land down to the Yalu River. The defending side was Goguryeo, centred on its capital at Pyongyang, with the Andong Grand Protectorate governing such places as Gaimou, Anshi and Liaoyang and the mountain fortresses along the river; King Gao Jianwu held court there and his brother Nanjian and others commanded the troops. The leader of the Mohe tribal group, the Prince of Anshi, came over to Tang with his people and handed Tang the key to Liaodong. In the southeast, King Seondeok of Silla sent the general Kim Heu-shin against Goguryeo towns, while King Uija of Buyeo sent envoys to court in public while secretly pledging to rise in concert with Tang. The coordinated moves of the three eastern states meant that this was no longer a two-sided contest between Tang and Goguryeo. In terms of arms, Tang fought with mixed infantry and cavalry field armies supported by siege-engine units, while Goguryeo relied on mountain fortifications, bows and crossbows and stone-throwing from the walls. Neither side possessed a stand-off weapon system capable of deciding the matter in one blow.
people: 唐太宗李世民是這場戰爭的絕對核心。他力排眾議執意東征，二月抵幽州下詔罪己，四月親臨安市城東北隅築土山，在山頂高台設帳，與城下守將書信勸降；圍城六十餘日不能下，七月詔班師，晚年仍歎『魏征若在，不使我有是行也』。尚書左僕射李勣即徐世勣，是出兵前唯一公開反對者，直言遼左連年凶旱、兵穀俱乏，請太宗審慎；太宗不聽，他仍任先鋒主將，拔蓋牟城、進逼平壤，是全軍唯一深入高句麗腹地的支線。李靖以行軍大總管節制諸道兵馬，長孫無忌等主海道大軍與糧道，韋挺為行軍總管督造攻城器械與軍用浮橋。守方主將是高句麗王高建武與其弟男建、男居，援軍由男建等率騎兵五萬餘人趨安市；安市城破後被俘的高句麗將領高延壽等數千人，其後獲授平壤郡王。新羅方面由金庾信統兵策應，百濟王義慈與其弟謀約內應而事洩，渤海王大祚榮則是最早向唐靠攏的宗主。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong Li Shimin was the absolute centre of this war. He insisted on the eastern campaign over the objections of his court, reached Youzhou in the second month and issued an edict taking the blame on himself, and in the fourth month personally supervised the raising of an earthen rampart against the northeast corner of Anshi, pitching his tent on a high platform at the summit and sending letters down to the garrison to persuade it to surrender. When the city was still standing after more than sixty days of siege, he ordered the army home in the seventh month, and for the rest of his life sighed that had Wei Zheng been alive, he would never have made this march. Li Ji, formerly Xu Shiji, Senior Vice President of State Affairs, was the only man to oppose the expedition openly; he told the emperor plainly that Liaodong had suffered years of drought and that both troops and grain were exhausted, and begged him to take care. The emperor would not listen, yet Li Ji still commanded the vanguard, took Gaimou city and pressed towards Pyongyang, the single thrust that penetrated deep into Goguryeo's hinterland. Li Jing, as Grand Chief of the campaign, controlled the several columns; Zhangsun Wuji and his colleagues led the great sea-borne force and its supply line; Wei Ting served as a column commander and supervised the siege engines and the military pontoon bridge. On the Goguryeo side the commanders were King Gao Jianwu and his brothers Nanjian and Nanju, the relief army of more than fifty thousand cavalry being led by Nanjian and others to Anshi. When Anshi finally fell, several thousand Goguryeo officers and men, including the general Gao Yanshou, were taken prisoner; he was later granted the title Prince of Pyongyang. Silla was represented by the general Kim Heu-shin operating in support of the Tang thrust, while King Uija of Buyeo and his brother were caught in a plot to rise in concert with Tang, and the king of the Mohe, the Bohai ruler Ta Zuorong, was the earliest of the northern powers to side with Tang.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬扭力弩砲(Scorpio)是古代投射技術的代表：以扭力絞盤把多股繩束或皮筋壓縮儲能，發射時一次釋放，一發一矢或一發一石，射程遠、彈道平直，羅馬人用它拆掉了希臘的城牆。在唐與高句麗之戰的技術座標裏，它對應的是同一條譜系的東方分支：唐軍攻城主力是拋石車與床弩。前者架在土山頂上，把石彈拋向城頭，通鑑記安市城攻城時『拋石所中皆中，人馬多斃』，高句麗守軍亦從城上擲石反擊；後者是車載大弩，一次可發矢數十支，射程數百步，用於壓制城頭射孔並掩護接近。此外唐軍還有巢車、可容數百人的木構觀敵車、撞車、蒙牛皮的蒙車與雲梯；高句麗則依靠環城木柵、險峻山道、弓弩與城頭投石反擊。轉輸方面，海船自萊州起運，車馬接力於營州、幽州、蓋州一線，糧秣由山東、河北諸州供應，役丁以十萬計，這條海陸並進的補給線是本役能夠長期圍城的唯一前提。
kitsEn: The Roman torsion catapult on the card, the Scorpio, is the emblem of ancient projectile technology: a torsion screw compresses bundles of cord or sinew and stores the energy, released in a single stroke, firing one bolt or one stone with long range and a flat trajectory, and the Romans used it to break the walls of Greek cities. Within the technological coordinates of the Tang-Goguryeo war, it corresponds to the eastern branch of the same family: the Tang siege train was built around stone-throwing engines and heavy crossbows. The former were mounted on the earthen rampart and hurled stones at the defenders; the chronicle records that at Anshi the stones always found a mark and that men and horses were frequently killed, while the Goguryeo garrison answered with stones thrown down from the walls. The latter, carriage-mounted heavy crossbows, discharged dozens of bolts at a time over several hundred paces, used to silence the wall embrasures and cover the approach of the engineers. The Tang also had observation towers on wheels that held several hundred men, battering rams, ox-hide-covered sheds and scaling ladders, while Goguryeo relied on timber palisades around the walls, steep mountain tracks, bows and crossbows, and stones thrown from the parapets. On the supply side, ships sailed from Laizhou and carts and horses relayed the freight along the Yingzhou, Youzhou and Gaizhou lines, with grain drawn from the prefectures of Shandong and Hebei and draughtsmen numbering in the tens of thousands. That combined sea and land supply route was the only precondition for a siege prolonged as this one.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術核心是分道合擊加上抬高砲位。主力自代州沿遼東走廊南下，太宗自洛陽、幽州方向出，二月抵北界、三月會師唐水，然後合圍安市城：先令工匠在城東北隅堆土成山，土堆高出城頭，再把拋石車架上山頂俯射，使石彈越過女牆直落院內；同時以巢車逼近觀敵，判斷城內佈防，再決定續攻還是勸降。高句麗的應對是把防禦核心放在山勢與溪流上，居高俯瞰，弓弩與投石交錯射擊，屢次趁夜襲擊唐軍土山，又在北山集結騎兵五萬餘人企圖逼退攻城部隊。唐軍在北山列陣迎戰，騎兵對騎兵正面衝撞，步兵結陣守住山腰，雖破其援軍，自身折損亦重。整個戰役另一條暗線是補給對峙：海運船隊要穿過渤海海面轉入鴨綠江口，陸隊要穿越被高句麗游騎切斷的糧道，班師之議最終在糧秣與士氣雙重壓力下拍板。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Tang army was convergence by separate columns combined with raising the firing position. The main body came south along the Liaodong corridor from Dai prefecture while the emperor moved out from Luoyang and Youzhou; they met at the Tang River in the third month and then closed on Anshi. The procedure was to have the engineers pile earth against the northeast corner of the city until the mound stood above the parapet, then mount the stone-throwing engines on the summit so that their shot cleared the curtain wall and fell into the enclosures below. At the same time wheeled observation towers were pushed forward to read the dispositions inside and to decide whether to keep battering or to offer terms. Goguryeo answered by making the mountains and streams the core of its defence, looking down from above, answering with bows, crossbows and stones in overlapping salvos, striking at the Tang rampart by night, and massing more than fifty thousand cavalry on the northern hill in an attempt to drive the siege works away. The Tang met them in line on that northern hill, cavalry charging cavalry while the infantry held the slope; the relief was broken, but at heavy cost. A second concealed current ran through the whole campaign, the contest of supply: the sea-borne fleet had to cross the gulf and turn into the mouth of the Yalu, while the land columns pushed through a grain road cut by Goguryeo's raiders, and the decision to withdraw was finally taken under the combined weight of food and morale.
data: 可考的數字如下：貞觀十九年正月下詔時，通鑑記唐軍出兵『十餘萬』，戰兵之外另有龐大運丁；東道一路由長孫無忌等率兵及丁夫數十萬，自萊州登船浮海，航程逾一千餘里，經登州、旅順口一線轉往鴨綠水，與李勣部會合。市攻方面，四月築土山於安市城東北隅，山高數丈，約當十餘米；圍城歷六十餘日不克，舊唐書另記為八十八日；高句麗王遣其弟男建等率騎兵五萬餘人赴援，兵敗於土山北麓。北道軍李勣部在貴髮水一線與高句麗大軍接戰，唐方記載該軍為十五萬，與安市城下的五萬餘騎兵分屬兩場不同的戰鬥，不可當作同一支兵馬。唐軍一度攻上土山東北角，守軍反撲奪回，數日後再克之，幾度易手。安市城破後，唐軍俘高句麗將領高延壽等數千人、俘虜以萬計，唐廷擇降戶安置於幽州、營州一線並授官爵。另一組數字是人力與物資的消耗：海陸兩線運丁以十萬計，班師時大批糧車與攻城器械留在城下未及攜歸，說明此役的失敗並非戰鬥失利，而是補給撐不住。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. When the edict went out in the first month of Zhenguan 19, the chronicle records a Tang force of 'more than a hundred thousand', with enormous numbers of draughtsmen on top of the fighting troops. The eastern column, under Zhangsun Wuji and others, took several hundred thousand men and labourers, embarked at Laizhou and sailed more than a thousand li, rounding the Dengzhou and Lüshunkou points and turning up the Yalu to join Li Ji's force. On the siege itself: in the fourth month a rampart was raised against the northeast corner of Anshi, several zhang high, that is on the order of ten-odd metres; the siege ran for more than sixty days without success, the Old Book of Tang giving eighty-eight days in its place; and Goguryeo's king sent his brother Nanjian with more than fifty thousand cavalry to the relief, which was defeated below the northern slope of the rampart. Li Ji's northern column had earlier met a far larger enemy on the Guifa River, a force Tang records at a hundred and fifty thousand; that figure belongs to a separate engagement and must not be run together with the fifty thousand cavalry that came to relieve Anshi. The Tang did at one point seize the northeast corner of the mound, the garrison stormed back and retook it, and the Tang took it again a few days later, the position changing hands repeatedly. After Anshi fell, the Tang captured several thousand officers and men including the general Gao Yanshou, with the prisoners numbered in the tens of thousands, and the court settled some of the surrendered households in the Youzhou and Yingzhou lines and granted them office. A second set of figures concerns the drain on manpower and materiel: the draughtsmen on the sea and land lines ran into the tens of thousands, and on the withdrawal large numbers of grain carts and siege engines were abandoned at the foot of the city rather than carried home, which shows that the campaign failed not through defeat in battle but because supply could not be sustained.
cause: 唐太宗要打這場仗，有遠因也有近因。遠因是隋煬帝三征高句麗皆敗而國力耗盡，平壤自隋末以來一直是唐廷眼中『必取之地』，太宗對前隋敗因有自己的判斷，認為其敗在驕惰、糧道不繼，而非兵力不足，故主張以精兵銳卒、乘勝直搗的方針改弦更張。近因在高句麗的內部：貞觀十九年前後，高句麗王高建武與其弟及貴人互相猜忌，內鬥接連死人，新羅乘勢攻破高句麗四十餘城，邊境秩序崩潰，唐太宗遂以『高麗侵新羅、新羅乞師』為名出兵，既有道義旗號又有實質戰機。更關鍵的是渤海靺鞨首領安市王率眾降唐，交出安市城內應與遼東通道；百濟亦遣使請救、密約內應。東亞外交近乎全數站在唐的一邊，太宗遂決定不等北方水患與糧運問題徹底解決即揮軍深入，趕在新羅攻勢最盛、高句麗注意力分散之際投入兵力，先取安市城以打開通往平壤的大道。
causeEn: There were distant causes and immediate ones behind Taizong's decision to fight. The distant cause was that the three Sui campaigns against Goguryeo had ended in failure while draining the empire, and that since the fall of the Sui the Tang court had held Pyongyang to be a place that must be taken. Taizong formed his own judgement of why the Sui had failed, holding that the fault lay in complacency and in supply lines that broke down rather than in any shortage of men, and so he proposed to change the method entirely and advance with picked troops and a rush on Pyongyang while momentum lasted. The immediate cause lay inside Goguryeo itself. In the years around Zhenguan 19, King Gao Jianwu and his brother and his nobles were locked in mutual suspicion, and one death after another inside the palace was followed by Silla taking some forty Goguryeo towns, so that the order on the frontier collapsed. Taizong accordingly went to war under the banner of 'Goguryeo has attacked Silla and Silla has asked for help', a cause that was both formally righteous and materially useful. More decisive still was the defection of the Mohe leader, the Prince of Anshi, who brought his people over to Tang and handed over Anshi itself and the corridor into Liaodong, while Buyeo sent envoys begging for help and secretly plumed an internal rising. East Asian diplomacy stood almost entirely on Tang's side, and Taizong therefore chose to advance without waiting for the northern floods and the supply question to be settled, throwing in his troops while Silla's offensive was at its height and Goguryeo's attention was divided, with Anshi to be taken first so as to open the great road to Pyongyang.
impact: 此役對唐與東北亞格局的影響，遠大於戰場上的得失。唐太宗傾國力而未能拔安市城，『不使我有是行也』的歎語成為其畢生憾事，645年之後他不再提第二次大舉東征，戰略由正面攻滅轉為長期羈縻、間諜與局部壓制，直到高宗朝才真正滅掉高句麗。技術層面的收穫最為實在：攻城砲位、築土山逼近法、巢車觀敵、海道運糧這套本役摸索出來的辦法，直接被後續的安市、渾江之戰沿用，成為唐後期東北戰爭的標準動作。國際格局上，高句麗雖未受重創，新羅卻藉唐軍牽制之機大幅南進擴張，渤海(靺鞨)則填補了高句麗退潮後留下的真空，把北方壓力轉化為新羅與渤海兩強在鴨綠江流域的長期對峙。唐朝在東北亞同時面對兩個不弱於高句麗的對手，邊防財政與役丁負擔由暫時性支出變成長期包袱，645年這場未竟之功就此轉化為唐朝東北政策的底色。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign for Tang and for the shape of northeast Asia reached far beyond what was decided on the field. Taizong had committed the wealth of the empire and had not taken Anshi, and the sigh that without Wei Zheng he would never have made this march became the regret of his life. After 645 he raised no second great expedition east; strategy shifted from outright conquest to long-term control through hostages, envoys and local pressure, and only under his son was Goguryeo actually destroyed. The most solid gains were technical: the raised firing positions, the rampart-and-mound method of approach, the observation towers on wheels and the sea-borne grain route, all worked out in this campaign, were carried straight into the later fighting at Anshi and on the Hun River, becoming the standard procedure of Tang's later wars in the northeast. Internationally, though Goguryeo was not badly hurt, Silla used the distraction created by the Tang army to expand far south, while the Mohe and later Bohai filled the vacuum left by Goguryeo's retreat and converted the northern pressure into a long rivalry between Silla and Bohai along the Yalu valley. The Tang now faced two opponents in northeast Asia no weaker than Goguryeo had been, and the fiscal and labour cost of the northern frontier turned from a temporary outlay into a permanent burden. The unfinished victory of 645 thus became the background colour of Tang northeastern policy for a generation.
result: 結果是唐軍沒有打下安市城，也沒有走到平壤。四月築山逼近城垣，其後數月攻城屢挫，史書稱圍城六十餘日而城不下，舊唐書另記為八十八日；七月太宗下詔班師，詔旨自責勞師久攻、糧運不繼，並赦免隨征將士。大軍經柳城一線撤回，勞役與連日行軍的疲耗在秋雨與斷糧中集中爆發，軍中無復戰意；年底前返抵長安，太宗在群臣面前歎息『魏征若在，不使我有是行也』，此役的失敗成為貞觀末年君臣反覆檢討的課題。戰果仍非全無：北道軍拔蓋牟等數城，唐軍取得若干城邑與大批攻城器械，降卒降戶按籍安置並授官，高句麗將領高延壽被俘後受封平壤郡王，渤海首領安市王以內應之功受封，說明唐在東北的人際佈局並未歸零。但高句麗王國本身完好，當年秋季便趁唐軍退出，重新收復新羅攻取的城邑；數年後唐高宗聯手新羅才完成貞觀十九年未竟之事，把平壤收入版圖，設安市、渾江、含鄰等州分割其地。
resultEn: The result was that the Tang army did not take Anshi and never reached Pyongyang. The mound was raised against the walls in the fourth month, the following months of assault brought one repulse after another, and the chronicles record that after more than sixty days of siege the city still stood, the Old Book of Tang counting the investment at eighty-eight days. In the seventh month Taizong ordered the withdrawal, his edict taking the blame for the long grind and the failing supply lines and pardoning the officers and men who had served under him. The army pulled back through the Liucheng line, and the exhaustion of months of labour and marching broke out all at once in the autumn rain and the empty supply wagons; there was no longer any heart for battle in the ranks. They were back in the capital before the year ended, and before his ministers the emperor sighed that had Wei Zheng been alive, he would never have made this march. The failure of the campaign became a subject the ruler and his ministers returned to again and again in the closing years of Zhenguan. Some results survived all the same: the northern column took Gaimou and other towns, the Tang gained a number of cities and a large haul of siege equipment, surrendered soldiers and households were enrolled and given office, the captured Goguryeo general Gao Yanshou was granted the title Prince of Pyongyang, and the Mohe Prince of Anshi was rewarded for turning the city over from within, which showed that Tang's network of alliances in the northeast had not been wiped out. But the Goguryeo state itself was intact, and by the autumn of that same year it took back the towns Silla had seized as the Tang army withdrew. Only some years later, when Taizong's successor took the field together with Silla, was the work left undone in Zhenguan 19 finally completed: Pyongyang was brought into the empire, and the new commanderies of Anshi, Hunjiang and Hanling were laid out to divide the old kingdom.
